Franklin-area accuracy

Franklin locations are core. Williamson County and qualified nearby organizations may participate when they serve Franklin, but the profile must display the actual physical city or service area.

Free correction remains separate

Anyone may suggest a factual correction without paying or becoming a member. Membership adds member-provided content and tools after authority verification.
